task: P12 'which side am I on' — close four defects in which a networked client runs an offline assumption: the local body never learns its replicated team (D-1), the offline scoreboard is tallied and painted over the server's numbers (D-2), the minimap marks every enemy (D-3), and unclaimed player-slot bodies stay AI-driven (D-4).
scoutSummary: P11 has landed (91492d7; ScoreUi's own doc says 'since P11'). Two scout findings changed the work. FIRST: offline, nothing calls Actor.SetTeam on the local player — GameManager.StartGame:88 only instantiates playerPrefab, and the prefab's authored team:0 IS the offline assignment, so removing it needs a replacement (added in FpsActorController.Awake, the same D16 literal MinimapUi:193 already carries). SECOND: Net/Client cannot name Actor (assembly boundary, check-net-layering RULE 6b), so the team apply routes through ILocalPlayerRig, the seam built for the rig's body, with FellBody as precedent. Verified the IsOffline gate on Actor.Die is safe for the SERVER: the server's team score lives in MatchStateMachine.ReportDeath (_score0/_score1), not in Unity's MatchScoreboard, so gating the engine tally does not stop the server scoring. ActorSnapshotEntry (Ironfront.Net.Protocol/Messages/SnapshotMessage.cs:42-73) carries NO highlight bit and neither does SpawnActorMessage, so 3.3's IsHighlighted() disjunct has nothing to read and is reported as a gap rather than faked. SpawnActorMessage DOES carry Team (ServerTickLoop.AnnounceNewActors), contradicting a stale comment in RemoteActorRegistry.OnSpawn that this phase corrects.
acceptanceCriteria: 1. A client the server put on team 1 renders its own body in red; a team-0 client renders blue. Evidence: two screenshots, one per client. NOT YET TAKEN — requires a two-client lane-B run.

2. Player Fps Actor.prefab no longer asserts team 0; the value comes from the snapshot and offline still colours correctly. Evidence: 1-line prefab diff (team: 0 -> -1) plus Editor read-back confirming team=-1 and all 6 object references still resolving.
3. The score labels hold the server's numbers across a capture flip. Evidence: before/after screenshot pair. NOT YET TAKEN — requires a live capture flip.
4. The minimap shows friendlies and not enemies, with an enemy provably inside CullRadius. Evidence: screenshot + server log line. NOT YET TAKEN — requires a two-client run.

5. Live body count on the server equals 40 bots + N humans, not 40 + N + (16 - N). Evidence: the new '[net] player slot pool filled: N claimable bodies, all parked' server log line. NOT YET TAKEN from a live run.
6. Each of the four detectors was observed RED against the un-fixed code and green after. Evidence: 5 mutations recorded in verification.json — DONE.
7. tools/ci.ps1 green. Evidence: 'CI PASSED', 02:33 elapsed — DONE (Unity step skipped, see verification.json).

publicContracts: ILocalPlayerRig gains `int Team { get; }` and `void SetTeam(int)`. Every implementer updated: LocalPlayerRigBinding (production), AbsentLocalPlayerRig (null object), and the two test fakes. CHANGED, intentionally, and noted.

FpsActorController.playerTeam changes from a public static FIELD to a public static read-only PROPERTY. Source-compatible for all three readers (ActorBlip.cs:50, AiActorController.cs:584 and :813) — all reads, no writes anywhere. Its unresolved value stays -1, so AiActorController:539's comment remains true.
FpsActorController.UNKNOWN_TEAM added as a public const (-1).
RemoteActorRegistry.ShouldMarkOnMinimap added as internal static (visible to the test assembly via the existing InternalsVisibleTo in Net/Client/AssemblyInfo.cs).
NetClientLocalCombatDriver.ApplyLocalTeam is internal static for the same reason.
MatchScoreboard, MinimapUi.SetMarker and ScoreUi.SetAuthoritativeState signatures UNCHANGED — the last is P11's and explicitly not owned by this phase.
blastRadius: Offline single-player: the local player's team now comes from FpsActorController.Awake instead of the prefab literal. Same value (0), one frame later, and now via SetTeam so the body is actually recoloured — which the prefab literal never did.
Networked client: the local body is recoloured once when the first snapshot naming its team arrives; the minimap loses every enemy blip; the score labels stop being repainted from local state.

Dedicated server: Actor.Die and CapturePoint.SetOwner stop feeding the engine-side MatchScoreboard. Verified harmless — the authoritative team score is MatchStateMachine._score0/_score1 via ReportDeath, and the flag multiplier reads MatchStateMachine.OwnedPointCount. The engine board at the server role was written and never read.
Server slot pool: 16 bodies are created with the bot brain suspended. Claim is now a no-op on that path; Release still resumes, unchanged.
